people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: Now therefore take twelve men out of the tribes of Israel, for every tribe a man.
translations.bsb: Now choose twelve men from the tribes of Israel, one from each tribe.
translations.kjv: Now therefore take you twelve men out of the tribes of Israel, out of every tribe a man.
